description: Structured evidence contract for a prompt-transformation rule under test in Hamlet's Ghost. This ledger preserves scope, outcomes, and promotion readiness without collapsing panel-specific preferences into universal findings.

characterization_axes.description: Per-rule classification computed from the 2x2 relationship between panel preference and human preference. Evidence slices keep their existing human_signal and evaluator_signal fields; the characterization label is computed at rule level.
characterization_axes.panel_preference_axis: Whether the evaluator panel prefers outputs produced with the rule at or above panel_preference_rate.
characterization_axes.human_preference_axis: Whether decisive human reviews prefer, disprefer, or are neutral toward outputs produced with the rule.

labels.aligned: Panel prefers the rule and humans also prefer it.
labels.divergent: Panel prefers the rule while humans disprefer it.
labels.llm_specific: Panel prefers the rule while humans are neutral or mixed.
labels.human_specific: Humans prefer the rule but the panel does not.
labels.neutral: Neither side shows a strong preference.
labels.insufficient_data: Too few decisive human reviews exist to characterize the rule.

characterization_axes.divergent_authorization: A divergent characterization is an escalation signal, not an automatic demotion or correction. It authorizes dashboard prominence, wiki annotation, and human review of the rule/panel/reviewer relationship. It does not by itself change rule status, evaluator prompts, or compiler behavior. See docs/pivot-2026-04-17-characterization.md.

panel_version.description: Evaluator-panel version used when producing evaluator_signal, for example muse_athena_apollo_v0_collapsed.

human_signal_attribution_method.description: How a human packet verdict was distributed across one or more rule evidence slices.
